images.promptContract:
Use case: illustration-story. ONE square 1:1 image, high-detail warm pencil-and-watercolor modern Taiwan children's picture book, natural light, textured clean environment, natural expressive faces and stable preschool proportions. Use reference sheet top row all five L058 for STYLE ONLY, not identity. Middle row refined L115/L118/L119/L128 proportions; bottom first three family anchors L154/L162/L163. Girl short dark bob with pink clip, pink cardigan, cream shirt, navy skirt, pink shoes. Father short dark hair, blue overshirt over cream top, dark trousers. Fixed 你 boy bottom-row fourth anchor L012: short slightly tousled dark hair, sky-blue T-shirt, green shorts, blue shoes, orange backpack only if natural. Teacher bottom-row last anchor L372-S02: dark low ponytail, teal blouse, light beige skirt, adult face distinct from shoulder-length-haired mother. No readable Chinese, letters, digits, zhuyin, logos, brand marks, labels, speech balloons or watermarks. Writing must be ambiguous loose pencil traces, not real characters/letters. Not anime, flat cartoon, simplistic watercolor, 3D or photo. Safe margins; meaning-bearing paper and gestures phone-readable.
教室桌邊，固定「你」小男孩握筆面對練寫紙，有些猶豫；主角小女孩在旁微笑鼓勵他，指向紙面。主角女孩是說話者，不是老師；男孩還在嘗試，不能畫成已完成後接受表揚。固定「你」使用既有角色參考，不是哥哥或小光。
